description: Bilingual synthetic corpus for scripts/asr-benchmark.mjs. WAVs are generated locally with macOS `say` (16 kHz mono) into recordings/benchmarks/fixtures/ and never committed. `utterances` are separated by `pauseMs` of silence so VAD segmentation and lost-segment counting are deterministic.
